description.value: Willow River General Store is a convenience and general store serving a small rural community in the Cariboo region of central British Columbia. Located along a remote stretch of Highway 16 corridor country, it is likely one of the few supply stops for touring cyclists passing through this sparsely populated area. As a general store in an isolated community, it may carry a broad range of everyday goods.

address.value: 488 Railway Ave, Willow River, BC V0J 3C0, Canada
